Dialogs.Dialog: Somehow, I feel like you're distracted...
Are you thinking about something else？
Could it be that... you're mad at me？
You don't... want to go home？
Hehe, at times like this... you know, right？
I don't mind holding hands, but what do you want to do？
Hehe, you don't need to be so nervous, okay？
Hehe, you're rushing it, you know？
It is. Because... I can feel your body heat directly...
Nothing. Just... your hand is surprisingly warm... hehe.
And it's a boy's hand. It makes my heart race a little. Hehe.
No. It's not that, I was just thinking, you really are a boy...
You can hold tighter, you know.
...Hehe, you won't squeeze hard enough to hurt. A little disappointing. Hehe.
Yes, yes, like that... I'm so happy...
We're just holding hands... it's weird, right... but it's kind of nice.
...Hehe, my heart's racing. Look... my cheeks are red, aren't they？
When we hold hands, I feel like even my heart gets warm.
How tightly you hold my hand, the feel of your palm and fingers... all of it passes.
Hehe. I might be a little biased as your girlfriend, but that's fine, right？
Holding hands like this... it's so couple-like, isn't it？
We're only touching hands... if we got closer, would it be even more thrilling？
My heart hasn't been listening to me at all for a while now...
...I hope we look like a real couple...
Of course. Any way you look at it, we're a couple.
Want to interlace our fingers too？
We're a couple, so interlacing is allowed, right？ ...There.
Holding hands like this, any way you look at it, we're a couple, right？
I can't wait to get there, but getting there quickly feels like a waste too...
Fun times end in a flash, huh...
My biggest regret is that a certain someone didn't hold my hand？
I wanted to hold hands, you know？
Ah. Look, look, isn't that house's garden lovely？
Hehe. Looking at me is nice, but you'll miss out if you don't look around too, you know？
Look, the nameplate on the door. A carved wooden heart... is it handmade？
Wow, really. Maybe the people here are newlyweds？
Hehe. I hope our new home is like that too.
Hey, doesn't that apartment look like it's from an old movie？
Now that you say it... it's very Showa era, maybe？
I wonder if there's a public bath nearby.
Huh？ A Showa-era apartment means a public bath nearby, of course？
Ah... that apartment building might have been in a movie.
Look, right there. I know I've seen that balcony from somewhere before.
That one？ It's nice, but... do you remember which movie？
I think it was a horror movie where the whole building was the body of a monster... hmm, which one was it？
Ah... hey, hey. Isn't that old house over there just perfectly the part？
That？ By "the part," you mean horror-ish？
No. I mean a witch's house.
But no chimney, so it's no good. Too bad.
Ah... look, on that power line. That bird couple.
Hehe. They're snuggled up close... but from their side, maybe we look even more snuggled？
Um... shall we make it look that way？
Geez... you don't have to ask about every little thing.
Yeah... there are suddenly more of them. Why, I wonder？
I've got a bad feeling... shall we hurry for now？
Ah, yes. Right. It's a little scary...
Ah... so cute. A kitten on the wall. So cute.
Huh, is it asleep？ But its tail is...
Hehe. Maybe it's chasing a mouse in its dream？
Ah, it woke up... hehe, it's looking around all confused. It was dreaming after all.
Ah... I thought it was a statue, but it's a dog. So big.
But its tail is wagging happily...
Sorry, I can't play with you. Big sis has her hands full with this one. Hehe.
Look, over there... aww, it went inside...
Inside... don't tell me, it's in there？ A peacock？
Is it a pet？ But keeping a peacock... I get the feeling, but wow.
Ah, that cloud... aww, it disappeared.
There was a cloud that looked just like you. ...I see. You'll disappear someday too...
Ah... Was that a shooting star？
...Ah, I forgot to make a wish. What a waste...
What did you want to wish for？
Ah, nice smell... what is it？
Smell？ I don't smell anything... isn't it your imagination？
Huh？ You know, this... how do I put it？ You can't tell？
I can tell that ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s hair smells nice, but...
Geez... springing that on me is a little unfair.
Looks like it might rain... maybe？
Even though I'm walking with you...
No. Even if it rains, under one umbrella... hehe. Don't you like that？
Mm... oh no, geez... something got in my eye...
Mm, it's no good. Can you look？
Ah, a junior high couple... hehe, both their faces are bright red. So cute.
If we'd met in junior high... would we have been like that？
...I wonder？ I think we'd probably be the same as now...
Hehe. Maybe once in a while, a fresh, innocent date, like junior high schoolers, would be nice？
Look, that old man and old woman over there. They must be married...
...Ah, the ones walking hand in hand...
How nice... if we could grow old like that, we'd be happy, right...
What's wrong？ You look really surprised...
Ah, um... do you happen to have a brother or relative who looks just like you？
Then, I must be mistaken？ There was a boy who looked exactly like you... it startled me.
...Hehe. Hey, there's a pretty woman in a red dress over there, right？
Yeah... a model, maybe？ With that figure, in clothes like that...
Hmm. So that's where your eyes go？
So cute...▼ Fine, you were cute, so I'll forgive you.
Look, a little girl ran by just now, right？
Yeah. ...How do I put it, she was smiling so happily, right？
Is it love, I wonder？ She may be little, but she's a girl. Thinking that made me smile... you know.
I was just thinking, I really am your girlfriend.
Yeah... but hearing it said like that is embarrassing...
Hey, that old man is so skinny, but he's riding such a huge motorcycle.
Do you want to ride a bike like that too？
A little... if I could ride one, would you sit on the back？
Hehe, sure. But with a bike, it'll be a problem when our family grows, you know？
Ah, that car's so small, it looks like a toy...
Really. It looks a bit cramped in there.
But smaller ones must be easier to drive...
Are you going to drive, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Hehe, maybe. When I get my license, shall big sis take you somewhere？
That's a foreign car that costs tens of millions of yen, right？
Hmm, I don't really know, but it's definitely a luxury car.
A cheaper, cuter car would be better... why do people want those, I wonder.
You didn't notice？ There was a siren earlier too, you know？
Geez. If you space out, you'll get in an accident and be the one carried off in an ambulance, okay？ I don't want that, okay？
Look, it just walked by... huh？ It was right there...
Hmm, what was that just now...？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, wait a sec. My shoelace came untied...
A lion... ah, a costume？ No, it's not. Out for a walk？ Huh？ Where's its collar？
What's wrong？ You look like you just saw something impossible...？
Ah, right. Do you know the story of the high-speed giant tortoise？
It's an urban legend about a giant tortoise racing down the road at top speed... you're looking at it？
...Yeah, just now... it must be a dream. Yeah. A dream, a dream.
J-just now... a car-sized c-c-cockroa... no, never mind. Yeah, never mind.
I said never mind！ A cockroa... that huge, flying around. Absolutely impossible.
That was definitely that director just now... he's famous, you know？ The best horror director in the world, you know？
Maybe you were mistaken, so don't be so down...
Yeah... but I wanted him to shake my hand...
That was close... who dropped this！
